- annotations should not solely be stored in duckdb. if the user exits the app or stops the server and views the same energy directory/archive, the previous annotations should display. so the annotation data will need to be stored someplace like local storage
- the annotations should appear in the raw data view as well
- there should be a way to clear all entered annotations (after the user confirms the action)

can you please implement this feature?

the following issue was discovered around this area: "Annotations snapshot run composition, so re-analyzing a source whose sessions grew silently under-matches runs
viewer/src/lib/energy/annotations.ts:17-29 — PromptRunAnnotation stores `logIds` 'at annotation time'. This repo's .energy files are appended to live and re-analyzed (the branch itself adds new session files). If a session's run extends after it was annotated (new requests with the same prompt/kind/agent), the run key (first log id) is unchanged, so the chronology still shows the chips on the whole run — but the mirror only tags the stored subset of log ids, and filtering by that tag silently counts only part of the run; if the run's first log id shifts (records inserted upstream, dedupe changes), the annotation stops displaying yet its old log ids still match the filter. It self-heals only if the user re-annotates that exact run. Fix: refresh logIds from the current chronology run when displaying/re-annotating, or re-derive them from the key on load. ". is it necessary for the logIds to be stored in local storage?
